root: ^I’ve been locked in here for days now. They sentenced me for assassinating the Episcopus Rattus or whatever the Council likes to call themselves. Why would a farmerer be interested in killing clergy?

^I only heard legends of the death sentence within these halls. The monsters here mean to tear me apart. One of them nearly succeeded, but I managed to pick up a metal item from its corpse. According to another who was locked in here it could be useful…
